A '''signaller''' was a device capable of communicating information over large distances. [[Shannon Voorson]] used a signaller left by her cousin, [[Deen Voorson|Deen]], to contact him regarding arrangements to steal a [[Colony Class 23669 power generator]] from the [[Kuat Freight Port]].<ref name="Slaying">{{JournalCite|9|Slaying Dragons}}</ref>
